description: Source implementation of the Metadata interface as an immutable class that wraps a JsonObject, providing methods to access and modify metadata associated with entities, specifically in the context of the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ImmutableMetadata
classes.description: Immutable implementation of Metadata that encapsulates a JsonObject and provides methods for immutable metadata manipulation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty Metadata instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance initialized with data from the provided JsonObject.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a boolean.

methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
